title: TA HASR KARWAN-E-AZA GHAM MANAINGE
body:
TA HASR KARWAN-E-AZA GHAM MANAINGE
Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Is Tarah Todh Jainge Ashkoun Ke Silsile
Jo Gham Tujhe Mile WoKisi ko naMile
Tu Gham Naseeb Hai Yeh Sabhi Ku Batayege… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2.WoTeen Din Ki Tashna Laabi Yaad Hai Humein
Sukhe Gale Pe Kund Churi Yaad Hai Humein
Pyasou Ku Unki Yaad Me Paani Pilainge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Sub Kuch Nisar Karke Issi Gham Ke Waste
Aulad Bejdenge Moharram Ke Waste
Mazloom-e-Karbala ki Safe gham Bichainge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Surat Nahin Hai Aur Koi Dil Ke Chain Ki
Rakhte Hai Apne Pas Nashani Hussain Ki
Hum Qabr Me Bhi Khaake Shifa Leke Jaienge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Abid Ki Chashme Zar se Behta Howa Laahu
Wo Bekasi-e-Zainab-o-Kulsoom Charsu
Bazar Me Khule Howe Sar Yaad Aainge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Har Saans Lamha Lamha Rahenge Shareeke Gham
Farshe Aza Pe Baith Ke Girya Karienge Hum
Teri Sada Me Apni Saadein Milainge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Jitna Khayal Tune Rakha Apne Laal Ka
Koi Bhi Itne pyar Se Paala Na Hoenga
Teri Musibatou ku Na Hum Bhool Paienge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Seene Me Jis Hussain Ke Daag-E-Hasan Bhi Hai
Yeh Wo Shaheed Hai Jo Ghareeb-Ul-Watan Bhai hai
Hum Karbala pochah ke Yeh Nouha Sunaienge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Dil Me Hamare Shouk-e-Ziyarath Hai Fatima
Mehdi ki Kaleem ki Hasrath Hai Fatima
Aainge Karbala Toh Yeh Nouha Sunaienge… Bibi Tere Hussain Pe Ansou Bahainge
<<MINI>>
Aye Madar-e-Hussain Aye Madar-e-Hussain
